# Always reported, independent of completeness: geometry is never clipped.
UNCLIPPED_LIMITATION = (
    "Source geometry intersecting the request bbox is retained whole and "
    "unclipped; polygons may extend outside the request bbox and the "
    "renderer is expected to clip them."
)


def build_limitations(complete, input_count, next_link_count):
    """Build the truthful limitation list shared by source metadata and audit.

    ``next_link_count`` counts listed input pages that were actually
    verified (from their parsed ``links`` arrays) to carry a
    ``rel == "next"`` link. A next page is never claimed without that
    verification, and a ``complete`` claim is scoped to the listed manifest
    bbox and listed collection inputs only -- never city-wide.
    """
    if complete:
        coverage = (
            "Completeness covers only the listed manifest bbox and the %d "
            "listed collection input page(s); any other bbox, area or "
            "collection is outside this completeness claim." % input_count
        )
    else:
        coverage = (
            "Incomplete listed inputs: the %d listed collection input "
            "page(s) only partially cover the listed manifest bbox, so "
            "feature counts describe only the listed pages and not any "
            "other area." % input_count
        )
        if input_count > 0 and next_link_count == input_count:
            coverage += (
                " Each of the %d listed source pages was verified from its "
                "links to carry a next page link, so further unlisted pages "
                "exist." % next_link_count
            )
        elif next_link_count > 0:
            coverage += (
                " %d of the %d listed source pages were verified from their "
                "links to carry a next page link."
                % (next_link_count, input_count)
            )
    return [coverage, UNCLIPPED_LIMITATION]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# completeness metadata (D26 GEO01 correction: truthful complete/limitations,
# strict boolean type; geometry must be unaffected by the completeness flag)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

class CompletenessMetadataTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _one_entry(self, with_next=True):
        return [
            ("w.json", "waterdeel", feature_collection(
                [make_feature("c1", polygon([square_ring(4.882, 52.371)]),
                              lokaal_id="L-c1")],
                "waterdeel", with_next=with_next))
        ]

    def test_complete_true_is_strict_bool_and_scoped_not_incomplete(self):
        # The page even carries a next link: complete=true must still never
        # describe samples, first pages, or next pages.
        ((data, audit), workspace) = convert_entries(
            self._one_entry(with_next=True), complete=True
        )
        try:
            self.assertIs(data["source"]["complete"], True)
            self.assertIs(audit["complete"], True)
            joined = " ".join(data["source"]["limitations"])
            lower = joined.lower()
            self.assertNotIn("incomplete", lower)
            self.assertNotIn("next page", lower)
            self.assertNotIn("small first", lower)
            self.assertNotIn("sample", lower)
            # truthfully scoped to the listed bbox and listed inputs
            self.assertIn("listed manifest bbox", lower)
            # unclipped-bbox limitation is retained on both branches
            self.assertIn("unclipped", lower)
            # source metadata and audit carry one consistent list
            self.assertEqual(
                data["source"]["limitations"], audit["limitations"]
            )
        finally:
            workspace.close()

    def test_complete_false_all_next_links_verified(self):
        ((data, audit), workspace) = convert_entries(
            self._one_entry(with_next=True), complete=False
        )
        try:
            self.assertIs(data["source"]["complete"], False)
            self.assertIs(audit["complete"], False)
            joined = " ".join(data["source"]["limitations"])
            self.assertIn("Incomplete", joined)
            self.assertIn("next page", joined)
            self.assertIn("verified", joined)
            self.assertTrue(audit["inputs"][0]["nextLink"])
            self.assertEqual(
                data["source"]["limitations"], audit["limitations"]
            )
        finally:
            workspace.close()

    def test_complete_false_without_next_link_makes_no_next_claim(self):
        ((data, audit), workspace) = convert_entries(
            self._one_entry(with_next=False), complete=False
        )
        try:
            joined = " ".join(data["source"]["limitations"])
            self.assertIn("Incomplete", joined)
            # unverified -> no claim that any page has a next page
            self.assertNotIn("next page", joined.lower())
            self.assertFalse(audit["inputs"][0]["nextLink"])
            self.assertIn("unclipped", joined.lower())
            self.assertEqual(
                data["source"]["limitations"], audit["limitations"]
            )
        finally:
            workspace.close()

    def test_complete_false_partial_next_links_wording(self):
        entries = [
            ("w.json", "waterdeel", feature_collection(
                [make_feature("c1", polygon([square_ring(4.882, 52.371)]),
                              lokaal_id="L-c1")],
                "waterdeel", with_next=True)),
            ("p.json", "pand", feature_collection(
                [make_feature("c2", polygon([square_ring(4.886, 52.374)]),
                              collection="pand", lokaal_id="L-c2")],
                "pand", with_next=False)),
        ]
        ((data, audit), workspace) = convert_entries(entries, complete=False)
        try:
            joined = " ".join(data["source"]["limitations"])
            self.assertIn("Incomplete", joined)
            self.assertIn("1 of the 2 listed source pages", joined)
            self.assertIn("next page", joined)
            self.assertNotIn("Each of", joined)
            next_flags = {item["file"]: item["nextLink"]
                          for item in audit["inputs"]}
            self.assertEqual(
                next_flags, {"w.json": True, "p.json": False}
            )
        finally:
            workspace.close()

    def test_invalid_completeness_types_rejected_without_coercion(self):
        workspace = FixtureWorkspace(self._one_entry())
        try:
            for invalid in ("false", "true", 0, 1, None, 2, ""):
                workspace.manifest["complete"] = invalid
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ib.BgtImportError, r"'complete'"):
                    ib.convert(workspace.manifest, workspace.base)
        finally:
            workspace.close()

    def test_geometry_sha_and_counts_unchanged_between_true_and_false(self):
        workspace = FixtureWorkspace(self._one_entry(), complete=False)
        try:
            data_false, audit_false = ib.convert(
                workspace.manifest, workspace.base
            )
            workspace.manifest["complete"] = True
            data_true, audit_true = ib.convert(
                workspace.manifest, workspace.base
            )

            # projected geometry/features deep-identical apart from metadata
            self.assertEqual(data_false["layers"], data_true["layers"])
            self.assertEqual(
                data_false["layers"]["water"][0]["polygons"],
                data_true["layers"]["water"][0]["polygons"],
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                data_false["layers"]["water"][0]["bounds"],
                data_true["layers"]["water"][0]["bounds"],
            )
            # identical input file evidence (sha + bytes)
            self.assertEqual(
                [(i["file"], i["sha256"], i["bytes"])
                 for i in audit_false["inputs"]],
                [(i["file"], i["sha256"], i["bytes"])
                 for i in audit_true["inputs"]],
            )
            # geometric audit counts identical
            self.assertEqual(audit_false["layers"], audit_true["layers"])
            self.assertEqual(
                audit_false["inputFeatures"], audit_true["inputFeatures"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                audit_false["outputFeatures"], audit_true["outputFeatures"]
            )

            def _strip_data(doc):
                copy = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
                copy["source"].pop("complete")
                copy["source"].pop("limitations")
                return copy

            def _strip_audit(doc):
                copy = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
                copy.pop("complete")
                copy.pop("limitations")
                return copy

            # full documents differ only in completeness metadata
            self.assertEqual(
                ib.dumps_json(_strip_data(data_false)),
                ib.dumps_json(_strip_data(data_true)),
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                ib.dumps_json(_strip_audit(audit_false)),
                ib.dumps_json(_strip_audit(audit_true)),
            )
            self.assertIs(data_false["source"]["complete"], False)
            self.assertIs(data_true["source"]["complete"], True)
            self.assertIsNot(
                data_false["source"]["limitations"],
                data_true["source"]["limitations"],
            )
        finally:
            workspace.close()

    def test_real_samples_false_with_four_verified_next_links(self):
        with open(REAL_MANIFEST, "rb") as handle:
            manifest = json.loads(handle.read().decode("utf-8"))
        data, audit = ib.convert(manifest, HERE)
        self.assertIs(manifest["complete"], False)
        self.assertIs(data["source"]["complete"], False)
        self.assertIs(audit["complete"], False)
        self.assertEqual(len(audit["inputs"]), 4)
        self.assertTrue(all(item["nextLink"] for item in audit["inputs"]))
        joined = " ".join(data["source"]["limitations"])
        self.assertIn("Incomplete", joined)
        self.assertIn("Each of the 4 listed source pages", joined)
        self.assertEqual(
            data["source"]["limitations"], audit["limitations"]
        )
